# Changelog

All notable changes to `merv-client` are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

## [4.0.25] — 2026-09-22

### Added

- **Local dashboard — suite rename:** pen icon on Test Suites card titles (hover); `POST /api/suites/rename` via `merv show-report` updates `testSuite.title` without changing report timestamps.
- **Consolidated Report — Suite Based Summary:** suite-title cards (same layout as Test Suites), View Cases → `merv-cons-title.html` with inline instance embed (`?testcase=` / `embed=1`).
- **Suite report embed:** URL `?testcase=` wins over `sessionStorage` so consolidated embeds show the correct case.

### Changed

- **Consolidated Report labels:** “Title wise” renamed to **Suite Based Summary**; panel width aligned with Test Suites.

## [4.0.24] — 2026-09-22

### Added

- **Playwright `merv.video`:** stitch highlighted action frames into a per-testcase MP4 (step PNGs still controlled by `merv.screenshot`).
- **Playwright expect steps:** report Expected / Actual for matchers such as `toBe`.
- **Playwright step list:** collapse Bounding box / Evaluate / Screenshot noise; show action + locator titles.

### Changed

- **`show-report` / `show-logs`:** if the report folder (e.g. `merv-reports`) is missing, create it and open an empty dashboard / Merv-Logs page instead of failing with "Report folder does not exist".

## [4.0.23] — 2026-08-31

### Fixed

- **`merv-tutor`:** ESM projects (`"type": "module"`) now generate an `import`-based runner; user scripts can use **`import`** or **`require`** (via `createRequire`).

## [4.0.22] — 2026-08-05

### Changed

- **`npx merv-client doctor set console`:** idempotent on re-run (no longer toggles off).
- **`npx merv-client doctor unset console`:** also reverts user-added `MervSystem` / console imports where applicable.

## [4.0.21] — 2026-08-04

### Added

- **Centralized logs (`merv.log.server`):** forward lines to another project's running report server (`/api/logs/ingest`) for a combined Merv-Logs view. Optional `merv.log.source` (project name). Local NDJSON is written first; remote send is async / non-blocking.
- **`npx merv show-logs`:** same server as `show-report`, opens `/merv-logs.html` directly. Doctor can add an npm `show-logs` script.
- **`npx merv-client doctor setup-log`:** Merv-Logs-only scaffold (`merv.properties` + `show-logs` / `show-report` scripts + `merv-client` dep). Does **not** create `jsconfig.json` or `scripts/custom-report.*`.
- **`npx merv-client doctor set console` / `unset console`:** toggle or remove doctor-managed `import { console } from 'merv-client'` / `require` lines (`// merv-doctor-console`) on files that call `console.*`.
- **Merv-Logs UI:** **Log server URL** button opens a popup to copy hub settings; **Stop refresh** / **Resume refresh**; `import { console } from 'merv-client'` mirrors to Merv-Logs.

### Changed

- Merv-Logs page template always refreshed from the package on `show-report` / `show-logs` so UI updates are not stuck on a stale report-root copy.

### Notes (carried from prior unreleased)

### Changed

- **Merv Local suite Share / Download:** suite heading (right of suite name) has **Share** (LAN link) and **Download** (emailable HTML + offline zip with root `index.html`). Download shows a popup with zip size. `merv show-report` exposes `/api/share-info` and `/api/prepare-download`.
- **`merv.emailable.html=true`**: interactive Extent-style `emailable-report.html` (Merv logo, machine, dashboard charts, timeline, tags table with pass%, scenario expand/steps, status/tag/machine filters, failures view).
- **Offline suite HTML:** Share/Download buttons are hidden when the report is opened via `file://` (offline zip).
- **Cucumber / plugin screenshots:** if no automation tool page is bound, Merv skips screenshots quietly and reports BDD step status only (no more `FAILED step … has no screenshot` / `no bound Playwright page` warnings for pure Cucumber suites).
- **Cucumber scenario finish logs:** when Cucumber 12 omits `testCaseResult`, status is derived from step results (no more `UNKNOWN`).
- **Undefined steps:** failure reason is now `Undefined step (no matching step definition loaded)` instead of a generic `Step failed`.
- **Cucumber Merv-Logs:** each Gherkin step (and Chai/plugin assertion row) is written to `log/*.ndjson` with status (`[PASSED]` / `[FAILED]`). When a step has a screenshot, it is attached on the same log line for the Merv-Logs live page.

- **Merv-Tutor:** removed from the local dashboard sidebar. Open the debugger with `npx merv-tutor open` instead.
- **`runShowReport`:** supports `openPath` (e.g. `/merv-tutor.html`) and is exported from `merv-client` with `resolveReportRoot`.
- **Merv-Tutor page (v14):** a persistent **Project Files** panel preserves nested paths across separate tutor commands as an expandable/collapsible folder tree (VS Code–style). Clicking a file shows only its source and execution process; re-running the same path replaces its trace. Only files explicitly executed through `merv-tutor` are listed.
- **Merv-Tutor console row:** split **60% console output / 40% analysis panel**. Per-file step and loop-iteration counts moved out of the Project Files list (now a hover title) into the analysis panel, which also shows estimated **time and space complexity** and max loop nesting for the file being viewed. Complexity comes from `files[].complexity` in the trace; traces written by older versions show `n/a`.
- **Merv-Tutor report location:** running from a nested folder now discovers the nearest `package.json` and writes only to **`<project-root>/merv-reports`**. Tutor no longer creates or requires `merv.properties` in the current folder.

### Fixed

- **Merv-Tutor empty state:** when `merv-tutor/latest.json` is missing the page now explains which file it expected and how to point at the right report folder, instead of rendering an almost-blank screen.
- **`show-report` port conflict:** when the port is already in use, the CLI now warns that the running server may be serving a different report folder (previously it silently opened that URL, which looked like a broken page).

### Added

- **`MervLogger`:** console logger (`info` / `debug` / `warn` / `error` / `trace`, named `getLogger`, `setLevel` / `configure`). Level from API, `MERV_LOG_LEVEL`, or `merv.logger.level`.
- **Merv-Logs:** `MervLogger` writes `{reportRoot}/log/merv-…5min….ndjson`; live page loads **100 lines** at a time (scroll up for older); `/api/logs/query` + `/api/logs/clear`. Logger lines also attach to the active custom-report testcase (`logs` + last step).
- **Doctor docs:** automated vs manual setup documented across `docs/DOCTOR.md`, READMEs, `FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md`, and website guides (`merv-local-*-js.html`, custom report).

### Changed

- **Peer dependency:** `@cucumber/cucumber` optional peer widened to `>=7.0.0` so projects on Cucumber 7+ (including 10 with `@cucumber/pretty-formatter`) can install without `ERESOLVE`.

### Added

- **Chai assertions:** optional integration records Chai `expect` / `assert` as MERV **`ASSERTION`** steps (Playwright + Cucumber). Enable with `merv.chai=true` (default) when `chai` is installed, or call `installMervChai(chai)` from `merv-client/chai`.
- **`merv.step.allowed`:** comma-separated allowlist of report step categories — `info`, `hook`, `assertion`, `action`. Categories not listed are omitted from the MERV report (and from plugin step attachments). When set, this overrides `merv.debug` / default / `merv.report.extra_step_types` filtering.
- **Playwright config screenshots & videos (reporter-only):** when only `merv-client/playwright-reporter` is registered (no bridge / wrapped `test`), the reporter copies Playwright’s own attachments from `use.screenshot` / `use.video` in `playwright.config` into the MERV run folder (`screenshots/`, `videos/`). Screenshots attach to steps; **videos** are stored on the testcase (`videos[]`) and shown under a **Video** label at the bottom of the case panel (not as a step).
- **`MervPlaywright.screenshot`:** Cucumber `AfterStep` helper (replaces `captureCucumberStepScreenshot`). Reads `merv.screenshot` from `merv.properties`; uses the page bound via `setAutomationToolObject`. `captureCucumberStepScreenshot` remains as a deprecated alias.

### Fixed

- **Local index dashboard:** with many report folders, the Test Suites view now loads **20 reports at a time** (JSON fetch + visible cards) with a **Load more** control for the next page — avoids stalling the browser when hundreds of runs exist. KPI / consolidated views use currently loaded reports until you load more.
- **Live suite report:** open testcase panel no longer re-renders on every JSON poll when that case’s data is unchanged (e.g. another case is executing). Case videos are only rewritten when the video list changes — so playback / streaming is not reset by background polls.
- **Playwright native screenshots** no longer become filtered-out `SCREENSHOT` rows when `merv.debug` is false — they attach to the last failed (or last) reportable step, or a visible “Playwright screenshot” step.

## [4.0.17] - 2026-07-28

### Fixed

- **`merv show-report`:** always run `writeIndexHtml` on start so a stale dashboard shell upgrades (e.g. missing **Merv-Tutor** nav link). Previously the index was only written when `index.html` was absent.

## [4.0.12] - 2026-07-27

### Fixed

- **Merv-Tutor debugger:** `ensureMervTutorPage` overwrites `merv-tutor.html` when the bundled template differs (fixes stale pages missing syntax / scope colors).

### Changed

- **`merv-tutor`** npm version aligned with **`merv-client`** at **4.0.12** (was `0.x`).

## [0.19.12] - 2026-05-27

### Fixed

- **Cucumber step screenshots:** skip PNG capture for **SKIPPED** / **PENDING** steps (`merv.screenshot=true` no longer screenshots steps that did not run).

## [0.19.11] - 2026-05-27

### Fixed

- **Cucumber step screenshots:** stash PNGs per `testStepId` (not a single global slot) and consume synchronously in the formatter before async work — fixes missing screenshots when steps run quickly. **Failed steps always capture** a screenshot (even if `merv.screenshot=false`). New helper: `captureCucumberStepScreenshot(page, { testStepId, result })` for `AfterStep` hooks.

## [0.19.10] - 2026-06-22

### Fixed

- **Cucumber live dashboard:** local runs now register on `index.html` at start (`running: true`), refresh `merv-index-data.json` after each scenario/step, and only mark the suite completed on `finalize()` — same live polling model as the Playwright reporter.
- **Playwright live dashboard:** `persistIncremental()` now updates `merv-index-data.json` during the run so suite cards refresh while tests execute.

## [0.19.9] - 2026-06-22

### Fixed

- **Cucumber step screenshots:** `MervPlaywright` binding and step PNG stash now use `globalThis` so hooks (`require('merv-client')`) and `merv-client/cucumber-formatter` share state. Use `MervPlaywright.stashStepScreenshot` from Cucumber `AfterStep` (while the page is open) for reliable `merv.screenshot=true` captures.

## [0.19.8] - 2026-05-27

### Added

- **Cucumber-js formatter** (`merv-client/cucumber-formatter`): BDD scenarios with Playwright steps report to Merv-Local or Merv-Server via `merv.properties`. Register in `cucumber.js` with `formatOptions: { merv: {} }`. Bind Playwright `page` with `MervPlaywright.setAutomationToolObject` in `Before` hooks for step screenshots.

## [0.19.7] - 2026-05-27

### Added

- **Upload ZIP:** local runs write **`merv-report-upload.zip`** (`json/merv-report.json` + screenshots) for MERV UI import. Enabled by default (`merv.zip.export=true`). Export **`packageLocalReportZip(runDir)`** for manual packaging.

## [0.19.6] - 2026-05-27

### Fixed

- **Shared suite mutex:** `mkdir`-based `create-mutex` so only one worker calls `POST /testsuites`; others wait and join. `resolveMervProjectRoot()` used consistently; set `MERV_PROJECT_ROOT` in npm scripts or `playwright.config.js`.

## [0.19.5] - 2026-05-27

### Fixed

- **Shared suite race:** parallel workers no longer create duplicate suites — atomic `suite-id` file (`wx` creator, others wait up to 15s). Session refcount still uses `coord.lock` so only one worker updates at a time. Set **`MERV_PROJECT_ROOT`** in `playwright.config.js` if workers resolve different `merv.properties` paths.

## [0.19.4] - 2026-05-27

### Fixed

- **`MervReport` server mode:** parallel Playwright workers now share **one** API test suite (coordination under `{project}/.merv-shared-suite/`). Suite is marked **COMPLETED** when the last worker calls **`finalize()`** (unless **`merv.execution.parallel=true`**).

## [0.19.3] - 2026-05-27

### Added

- **`MervReport`** reads **`merv.properties`**: when **`merv.local=false`**, explicit **`createTest` / `data` / `validation` / `info`** stream to **merv-api** without the Playwright reporter. Each **`MervReport.open()`** is an isolated session (safe across workers). **`await MervReport.open()`** and **`await finalize()`** are required.

## [0.19.2] - 2026-05-27

### Added

- **Server mode:** clear banner when `merv.api_key` is expired or rejected (`401`/`403`): `API Key is EXPIRED`. Exports `MERV_API_KEY_EXPIRED_MESSAGE`, `isMervApiKeyExpiredError`, `logMervClientError`.

### Fixed

- **Playwright screenshots (local + server):** `merv-*` viewport attachments from `merv.screenshot=true` are merged onto the matching report step instead of being dropped (`SCREENSHOT` rows were filtered out; `Attachment: merv-*` did not match the old merge pattern). Server mode now persists in-memory PNGs for upload and resolves paths for `uploadStepFile`.

## [0.18.0] - 2026-05-25

### Added

- **Playwright server mode** (`merv.local=false`): reporter streams testcases and steps to **merv-api** (suite bootstrap, `finishTestCase`, plugin + Playwright steps, optional step screenshot upload). New exports: `MervApiClient`, `MervPlaywrightServerSync`, `loadMervConfig`.

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- Per-run **`json/failure-test.json`**: failed testcases with name, status, failure reason, and all **TEST_DATA** / data steps; linked from suite HTML as **Failures JSON**. On suite completion, the same file is copied to **`{runFolder}/failure-test.json`** and **`{reportRoot}/failure-test.json`** (always the latest finished run).
- Local dashboard (**`index.html`**): **Advanced search** in the left sidebar — expandable tag pills, pass/fail/skip/in-progress filters, and testcase text search; filters consolidated rows and suite cards.
- Suite reports (`merv-report-live.html`, `merv-report.html`): **Advanced search** in the left sidebar — filter testcases by name, tags, and status (same run).
- Playwright reporter: testcase **tags** derived from the title path — **`@word`** tokens (e.g. `@login`, `@abc`) and **browser** tags (`chromium`, `firefox`, `webkit` when the project or title names them). Suite HTML (`merv-report.html`) and the sidebar now show tag pills.
- Documentation: **Option A** step-by-step (`jsconfig.json` + `package.json` `"imports"` + bridge) to keep `import from '@playwright/test'` with MERV wrapped `test` and `MervPlaywrightHandler` — see **README.md** and **FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md** §4a.
- **`MervPlaywrightHandler`**: renamed **`addDataStep`** → **`data`**, **`addValidationStep`** → **`validation`** (old names kept as deprecated aliases). Optional last argument **`screenshot: true`** on **`data`** / **`validation`** captures a viewport PNG for that plugin step (requires bound Playwright `page`).

### Changed

- **`validation(stepName, expected?, actual?, screenshot?)`** — removed **`testdata`** and **`prereq`** parameters (use **`data()`** / **`info()`** for those row types).

### Fixed

- Plugin-step screenshots (`data(…, true)` / `validation(…, true)`) work when **`merv.screenshot=false`**: the wrapped `test` fixture now always binds **`MervPlaywright`** to the active `page` (action auto-screenshots remain gated by **`merv.screenshot=true`** only).
- **`merv.screenshot=true`**: viewport PNGs are now captured after each Playwright **`expect()`** matcher (pass or fail), not only after page/locator actions. Reporter merge prefers attaching **`merv-expect-*`** screenshots to the matching **EXPECT** step row.

### Changed

- Playwright config subpath renamed to **`merv-client/playwright-reporter`** (clearer than `merv-client/reporter`). **`merv-client/reporter`** remains exported as a deprecated alias.
- Local dashboard (`index.html`): **`merv-index-data.json`** is updated during runs instead of rewriting **`index.html`**; the page polls every 5s and patches suite cards + KPI charts (Live Server reload blocked).

### Fixed

- Playwright reporter: **multi-project** runs (e.g. Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) no longer overwrite each other in `merv-report.json`. Map keys now prefer Playwright’s per-project **`test.id`**; if `id` were missing, keys fall back to **`project:file:line:column`** instead of location alone.
- Local dashboard (`index.html`): removed full-page **`location.reload()`** when new runs appear. Suite cards, KPIs, consolidated views, and charts now refresh via **AJAX** (`pollAll` every 5s on JSON + folder sync from regenerated `index.html`).
- Live suite report (`merv-report-live.html`, Playwright / `merv-client-js`): during a run only **`merv-report.json`** is written; the live HTML shell is static. The page polls JSON via AJAX and **incrementally** updates the sidebar (new cases appended, existing rows patched) and the selected testcase panel (steps/meta patched in place). Selection persists by test case name (`sessionStorage` + `?testcase=`). **VS Code Live Server** `reload` WebSocket messages and **`location.reload()`** are blocked on live pages (JSON updates still work). Playwright no longer rewrites **`index.html`** after every test.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-05-10

### Added

- Published npm package name **`merv-client`** (install with `npm install -D merv-client`; imports such as `from 'merv-client'` and `from 'merv-client/reporter'`).
- Playwright reporter subpath `merv-client/reporter` for Merv-Local JSON/HTML under `merv.report.folder`.
- `MervReport` / `MervExplicitLocalReport` for explicit local reports without the Playwright reporter.
- `MervPlaywrightHandler` and plugin step helpers (`addDataStep`, `addValidationStep`, `info`, …) aligned with the Java client.
- `merv.properties` resolution (report folder, suite title, screenshot mode, debug / extra step types, plugin assertion soft mode).
- Playwright test shim subpath `merv-client/playwright-test` and wrapped `test` for action screenshots.
- This package’s first published npm release with Apache-2.0 license and integration documentation.
